expected.charges: Accused in Senate proceedings of assisting Soviet intelligence; the allegation was denied and was not resolved in a U.S. criminal trial before he left the country.
expected.sentence: Left Mexico for the Soviet Union amid possible extradition; later moved from the USSR to Cuba.

updates.sentence:
Left Mexico for the Soviet Union amid possible extradition; later moved from the USSR to Cuba.

The State Department statement printed in the Congressional Record on August26,1960, pp17792–17793, dates his move to Mexico to November28,1953 and departure from Mexico to October13,1958; it reports his own statement that he had lived in the USSR since December1958. The exile start records departure from the United States for Mexico, rather than the later Soviet move. The existing1962 endpoint concerns his subsequent move to Cuba, not a verified return to the United States. Source: https://www.congress.gov/86/crecb/1960/08/26/GPO-CRECB-1960-pt13-7-1.pdf#page=54
